title: Extract a shared pumpApp test helper instead of duplicating ProviderScope/MaterialApp scaffolding across 9 settings test files
why: 9 of the 11 files in this batch hand-roll their own ProviderScope+MaterialApp+localizationsDelegates+supportedLocales widget factory (scope_lifetime_l1_test.dart alone defines 3). No test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists anywhere in the repo despite TQ-3 naming it as the reviewed convention — the only genuinely shared harness in this batch is the unrelated overflow_harness.dart. Each copy can drift independently: a future required override has to be hand-added to every one of these ~10 near-identical blocks instead of once, and a missing delegate/override in one copy silently produces different behavior (e.g. RTL/l10n) than its siblings.
recommendation: Introduce test/helpers/pump_app.dart exporting a pumpApp/buildTestApp helper that wraps ProviderScope(overrides) + MaterialApp(locale, delegates, supportedLocales, home), and migrate these 9 local builders to call it, keeping only the per-screen `home` widget and override list as parameters.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and is imported by the 9 files listed in evidence in place of their local _buildApp/_buildSettings/_buildHarness/createTestWidget/_buildScopeApp functions.
